change_from_run03: Excluded 13 absolute-fee context aggregates (subtype_avg_fee, propertytype_avg_fee, office_region_avg_fee, office_avg_fee, client_avg_fee, client_std_fee, segment_avg_fee, segment_std_fee, state_avg_fee, rolling_avg_fee_segment, rolling_avg_fee_state, rolling_std_fee_segment, segment_x_state_fee).
rationale: Run #3 still saturated despite cleaner LOO encoding because subtype_avg_fee (20% importance) and other context aggregates absorbed the signal. The hypothesis: force the model to weight BidFee more by removing the aggregates it leans on.
result: SUCCESS on fee curve, COST on AUC
verdict: v3_fee_sensitive is the right model for the EV-optimizer use case. The AUC drop is real but acceptable — it produces a usable fee-elasticity curve where v2 and v3_default both saturate. The right deployment path: use v3_fee_sensitive as a replacement for the hand-tuned heuristic sigmoid in the API's saturation fallback.
